lines: n1
[serious, gripping news-anchor tone] The most powerful man in AI just admitted an AFFAIR. [pause] And this isn't just GOSSIP.
n2
[measured, factual] The CEO of Nvidia, [short pause] Jensen Huang, [short pause] told his staff he was unfaithful to his wife.
n3
[careful, serious] Reports say the woman was being watched by US INTELLIGENCE [short pause] over ties to China. [short pause] She hasn't been charged.
n4
[measured] Nvidia's board opened an INVESTIGATION, [short pause] and says it has no reason to believe any secrets leaked.
n5
[intrigued, leaning in] So why is the WHOLE AI world watching?
n6
[building, explaining] Because Nvidia makes MOST of the chips that power today's AI. [short pause] It's worth about FOUR AND A HALF TRILLION dollars.
n7
[sharp] On Monday, [short pause] the stock fell about FIVE percent.
n8
[tense, building] Next week, [short pause] Nvidia reports earnings. [short pause] The day after, [short pause] CONGRESS wants answers.
n9
[slow, ominous] If trust in Nvidia... CRACKS,
[heavy, impactful] EVERY AI company built on its chips... feels it.
[direct, inviting debate] So, [short pause] should he STAY as CEO? [short pause] Comment below.
